notes: Build84 refinement after real-browser homologation. Validated compact launcher dimensions are restored exactly: FAB 58px desktop, rail mask 52px, rail buttons 34px, canonical detail technical foot/state rows hidden, and clicking the active rail icon closes its open menu. Editor Direct remains the unique functional authority. Project auto-binding runs only on explicit/page-load events and uses fail-safe unique name matching: existing binding first, then single/strong GitHub match, then strong GitHub-repository-to-Supabase-project name correspondence; a matched resource may be added to the current Decrypter selection without deselecting any other resource. GitHub Sync/history/compare stays read-only, event-driven and fail-closed; history and compare results use fixed-height scroll cards. Resource selection, Editor binding, GitHub Sync/history/compare and Supabase manager operations share the faster high-contrast red testing pulse and light-green success check feedback. Supabase Manager v2 and Gemini v2 remain otherwise unchanged from their successful browser tests. No MutationObserver, continuous polling, shell inert takeover, mount guardian, network monkeypatch or heavy provider activation at boot is shipped.
